home.heroBadge: Smart Agriculture • Better Markets • Higher Returns
home.heroDesc: FarmOS helps farmers discover better market opportunities by combining real mandi prices, logistics costs, weather intelligence and buyer discovery.
home.feature1Desc: Official Government of India Agmarknet feeds. Filter by state, district, market, commodity, and grade with min, max, and modal prices per quintal.
home.feature2Desc: Ranks regional APMCs simultaneously by estimated gross return, distance, transport cost, and FarmOS Opportunity Score (0–100).
home.feature3Desc: Calculates real road driving distances and travel times. Auto-selects vehicle types (Mini Truck, Canter, Multi-Axle) and exact freight cost.
home.feature4Desc: Connect with wholesalers, millers, and verified FarmOS registered buyers matching your commodity specs and volume.
home.feature5Desc: Conversational assistant explaining market trends, logistics calculations, and weather advisories in simple language.
home.taglineSub: Connecting Every Harvest to Its Best Opportunity
home.oneDecisionDesc: FarmOS combines multiple real-world factors to help farmers evaluate where their harvest may create the best opportunity.
home.workflowSub: A complete ecosystem to help farmers make better selling decisions.
home.coreEngineSub: Find Where Your Harvest Can Earn More.
home.featuresHeadline: Everything Farmers Need to Make Better Decisions
home.desktopExpDesc: Full analytical dashboard with multi-market side-by-side table comparisons.
home.mobileReadyDesc: Touch-optimized cards for fast mandi price checks right from the farm field.
home.aiInterfaceDesc: Ask Gemini AI about market trends, transport costs, and weather forecasts anytime.
home.farmosAnywhereSub: Access your farm, markets and opportunities from any device.
